title: Potential Effect of Cyclophosphamide on Bleb Survival in Five Patients with Multiple Sclerosis Who Underwent Glaucoma Surgery

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License); non-commercial, therefore private

indication: progressive severe glaucoma uncontrolled on maximally tolerated medication in patients with relapsing progressive multiple sclerosis receiving systemic cyclophosphamide (oral maintenance for at least 2 months before surgery); mitomycin C augmented trabeculectomy (phaco-trabeculectomy in four eyes; repeat ab externo filtering surgery without phaco in one eye with a previously failed phaco-trabeculectomy); case series, one eye per patient

groups.description: Patients 1 to 4 of Table 1: primary MMC phaco-trabeculectomy under systemic cyclophosphamide
Patient 5 of Table 1 (footnote 'surgical failure history'): new MMC ab externo filtering procedure after a failed phaco-trabeculectomy, under systemic cyclophosphamide

series.notes: columns PRE-OP, Day 1, At 1 week, At 2 weeks, At 1 month, At 3 months, At 9 months, At last follow-up (value C9 with its time in C10, '36 m'); oral cyclophosphamide interrupted 3 months after surgery (Methods)

last follow-up time '20 m' (Table 1 C10); footnote '*': MMC sub-Tenon bleb needling on postoperative day 15 and additional beta-blocker therapy (Results), so values from 1 month onward follow the needling
last follow-up time '17 m' (Table 1 C10); footnote '**': previous failed phaco-trabeculectomy

exclusions.what: Mean preoperative and last-follow-up IOP in the Results text
exclusions.reason: group summary of the same eyes whose per-eye values are extracted; the last-follow-up mean is untimed

exclusions.what: Table 1 column C10 (time of last follow-up)
exclusions.reason: time label, used only to set the month of each patient's last-follow-up value

notes: Reference: preoperative IOP under maximally tolerated medication (Methods), recorded as preoperative_medicated.
Table 1 header: 'At last follow-up' spans two columns (C9 value, C10 time in months, footnote 'm months'); each patient's last-follow-up value is therefore timed and is placed at its stated month.
Per-eye values exist, so individual series are extracted; times: day 1 = 1/30.4375, 1 week = 7/30.4375, 2 weeks = 14/30.4375 months.

Role: the patients' systemic cyclophosphamide is their multiple sclerosis therapy and no arm is declared experimental, so both groups are recorded as control with the condition in the indication; the article's subject is the potential effect of cyclophosphamide on bleb survival (flagged for review).

The Abstract describes all five eyes as phaco-trabeculectomy, whereas the Methods state that the eye with a previously failed phaco-trabeculectomy underwent a new ab externo filtering procedure; the Methods are followed.
Postoperative IOP was measured every 3 days during the first 15 days, then monthly up to 1 year (Methods); only tabulated visits are used.
